tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The black everything sits on; never tinted.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels and grouped areas (BPM/EQ panel, mappings list) on ground.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, rows, buttons at rest; one step above panel.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Non-interactive hairline dividers between rows and sections. Decorative only, not for control borders.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Control borders, focus outlines at rest, meter frames. 3.5:1 or better on ground, panel and raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on ground, panel and raised (14:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, micro-labels, units (6.8:1+ on raised).

tokens.name: palette-1
tokens.usage: Show palette slot 1, default Acid. Swappable per show; every slot must reach 4.5:1 on raised.

tokens.name: palette-2
tokens.usage: Show palette slot 2, default Hot. Swappable per show; every slot must reach 4.5:1 on raised.

tokens.name: palette-3
tokens.usage: Show palette slot 3, default Ice. Swappable per show; every slot must reach 4.5:1 on raised.

tokens.name: palette-4
tokens.usage: Show palette slot 4, default Violet. Swappable per show; every slot must reach 4.5:1 on raised.

tokens.name: palette-5
tokens.usage: Show palette slot 5, default Sun. Swappable per show; every slot must reach 4.5:1 on raised.

tokens.name: palette-6
tokens.usage: Show palette slot 6, default Mint. Swappable per show; every slot must reach 4.5:1 on raised.

tokens.name: palette-7
tokens.usage: Show palette slot 7, default Blue. Swappable per show; every slot must reach 4.5:1 on raised.

tokens.name: palette-8
tokens.usage: Show palette slot 8, default Bone. Swappable per show; every slot must reach 4.5:1 on raised.

tokens.name: midi
tokens.usage: MIDI role: selected tab, primary button, active pad, learn state. Follows palette slot 1.

tokens.name: bpm
tokens.usage: BPM role: beat dots, tempo readout, BPM mappings. Follows palette slot 2.

tokens.name: audio
tokens.usage: Audio/EQ role: spectrum bars, level meter, EQ mappings. Follows palette slot 3.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warnings and danger only: missing targets, panic, disconnected, hazard stripes. FIXED: never part of a show palette. Always with a label or stripes, never color alone.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any palette or warn fill.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase micro-labels with index numbers; ink-muted.

styles.name: readout-xl
styles.usage: BPM and delta-time hero numbers; tabular figures.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: MIDI addresses, values, ms timer, property URIs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between meter segments, icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside rows and buttons, between related controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gap between rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen margins on large displays.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Hero spacing, cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default: panels, buttons, rows, blocks. Neon Flat is square.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Meter segments and pads, just enough to read as hardware keys.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status lights and beat dots only.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules and control borders.

tokens.name: stroke-bold
tokens.usage: Focus rings, selected tab underline, active borders.
